topic: Training your own AI model costs less than people think, and more than it is worth
angle: Real numbers on what a from-scratch model actually costs
hook: Training your own AI video model costs $200,000
caption:
People ask what it takes to train a video model from scratch. Here are the real numbers, published by the teams who did it. The cheapest credible attempt was celebrated precisely because it was 90% cheaper than everything before it.

🔖 Save this — you'll want it when it's relevant.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#ai #machinelearning #startups #techbusiness #founders

slides.text: Training your own AI video model costs *$200,000*
slides.subline: And that is the cheap one

slides.text: The number people guess is either wildly low or wildly high. Here is what the teams who actually did it published.

slides.caption: what the $200k bought: 224 H200s running for weeks

slides.left_text: $200k minimum, a research team, and months before you know if it worked.
slides.right_text: About fifty dollars and a weekend to find out if the idea has legs.

slides.title: The part that matters
slides.body: The model is not the moat. Anyone can rent the same GPUs. What is defensible is the data nobody else has, or the specific job you solve better.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
